caribbean.headline: Small Craft Seas and Heavy Rain Threaten Antigua Ports
caribbean.paragraph: Antigua is experiencing sustained easterly winds near 24 kt with significant wave heights to 11.8 ft from a 9 s ENE swell and 75% rain probability. I advise small craft to remain sheltered, port operators at Antigua and Roatan (where winds reach 25 kt) to secure loose gear, and crews to expect brief heavy downpours and gusty conditions.

mediterranean.headline: Small Craft Conditions Near Mykonos; Dubrovnik Remains Calm
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing west-northwest winds up to 26 kt with significant wave heights around 7.1 ft and a dominant 7 s WNW swell, with less than 10% rain probability. I recommend small craft operators treat conditions as Small Craft Advisory thresholds for exposed waters and secure vessels, while Dubrovnik remains much lighter with winds near 12 kt.
